[comment by malte0811 (owner)]
Did you test whether the crash goes away if you remove FerriteCore? This is a type of crash that FerriteCore cannot really cause directly (only by triggering a bug in the JVM itself). Advanced rendering mods have "better chances" of causing this sort of crash, but still not very high. I see various errors in the log, some of them probably related to mods not expecting Pojav/Android environments.
